context: Evaluates correct implementation of the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE flow. The candidate must generate PKCE parameters correctly (code_verifier, S256 code_challenge), build a properly parameterized authorization redirect, and handle the callback with state validation and code exchange including the code_verifier. Security correctness is the primary focus.

checklist.name: PKCE code_verifier generation
checklist.description: Generates code_verifier using a cryptographically secure source (e.g. crypto.randomBytes) and encodes it to base64url with length >= 43 characters

checklist.name: S256 code_challenge derivation
checklist.description: Computes code_challenge as base64url(SHA-256(code_verifier)) and sets code_challenge_method=S256

checklist.name: Authorization redirect parameters
checklist.description: Includes all required parameters in the authorization redirect: response_type=code, client_id, redirect_uri, scope, state, code_challenge, code_challenge_method

checklist.name: State CSRF protection
checklist.description: Generates a random state value, stores it in the session before redirect, and validates it matches the value returned in the callback

checklist.name: Token exchange with code_verifier
checklist.description: Sends the code_verifier (not code_challenge) in the token exchange request to the authorization server's token endpoint
